title: Signature Term Frequency Grid
description: Signature Term Frequency Grid is a analysis ability in the Signature Cross-Document Heatmaps database. Builds a document-by-term grid showing where each term burns hottest. Terms are counted per document and normalized by document length; the grid renders as color intensity. It takes document set, term list and produces frequency grid. Tunable parameters: normalization: per-1000-tokens. Guarantee: counts are always length-normalized. title: Signature Topic Cluster Overlay
description: Signature Topic Cluster Overlay is a analysis ability in the Signature Cross-Document Heatmaps database. Overlays topic clusters on the heatmap so themes show as warm regions. Topics from a topic model are mapped to their member terms; cluster warmth is the mean of member warmth. It takes topic model, frequency grid and produces clustered heatmap. Tunable parameters: min cluster size 3. Guarantee: every warm cell belongs to a named cluster.
